setup_choose_backend_description: Elige quomodo instrumenta institutionis tua data communicant. Migrare potes postea ex Optionibus Admin.
setup_firebase_description: Sequere gradus infra: elige organisationem, incolla Firebase project details, deinde sign in cum Google.
setup_firebase_auth_hint: Sign in debet succedere ante primam sync. Utere eodem Google ratione in omni instrumento admin.
firebase_org_id_hint: Nomen commune institutionis tuae (exemplum: noctulist-club). Idem ID in omni instrumento.
firebase_sync_subtitle: Sync tempore reali pro hospitibus, voluntariis, POS et instrumentis portae.
firebase_settings_intro: Sequere gradus infra. Utere guide ? si opus est auxilium in Firebase Console.
firebase_status_need_sign_in: Fere paratus — sign in cum Google
firebase_step_org_body: Hic ID omnes apparatus eiusdem institutionis in Firestore colligit.
firebase_step_project_body: Copia Project ID, Application ID, API key, Web client ID et (Desktop) Web client secret. Aperi guide ? et elige Firebase Console vel Google Cloud Console.
firebase_step_project_where: Solum projectum Firebase/Google Cloud institutionis. Ne utaris JSON OAuth Gmail Desktop developer pro Sign-In.
firebase_web_client_id_hint: OAuth 2.0 Web client ID institutionis (Firebase Google Sign-In). Non JSON OAuth Gmail Desktop developer.
firebase_web_client_secret_hint: Secret client Web institutionis (Desktop + Android). URI redirectionis auctorizatae (non origines JavaScript): Desktop — http://localhost:8889/Callback (et :8888, :8765, :9090). Android — com.eventmanager.app:/firebaseoauth2callback (sine SHA-1).
firebase_step_signin_body: Auctoriza hoc instrumentum. Primum ratio admin fit administrator organisationis.
firebase_checklist_project: Project ID, Application ID et API key impleta
firebase_config_paste_hint: Incolla config SDK web Firebase Console (apiKey, appId, projectId). Solum adminibus opus est.
firebase_join_qr_body: Alia instrumenta scan hoc codicem in Setup → Join. Secreta non monstrantur in illis instrumentis.
firebase_join_qr_need_config: Imple primum org ID et optiones projecti ut generes QR join.
firebase_join_scan_body: Scan QR admin vel incolla codicem join. Secreta projecti manent celata in hoc instrumento.
firebase_join_received: Configuratio Firebase recepta — sign in cum Google ut procedas
firebase_join_wizard_option_body: Scan QR join admin. Non opus est scribere API keys.
firebase_team_body: Quisque qui Firebase utitur debet registrari ut membrum org cum role. Sine hoc Google Sign-In succedit sed Firestore omnes lectiones et scripturas bloqueat.
firebase_team_steps:
1. Rogo aperire hanc app → Sync settings → Sign in cum Google semel.
2. Copia eorum Firebase UID (Firebase Console → Authentication → Users, vel ex instrumento post sign in).
3. Incolla UID infra, adde email si scis, deinde tange buttonem role.
firebase_team_role_admin_desc: Admin — optiones plenae, migratio, invitare alios, omnia data.
firebase_team_role_door_desc: Porta / billetterie — index hospitum, jobs, loci (Billeterie).
firebase_team_not_domains: Non idem ac «Allowed Google email domains» supra: domaines solum filtrant sign in; haec sectio dat accessum ad data institutionis in Firestore.
firebase_email_domains_body: Solum rationes Google quarum inscriptio in uno horum domainum finit potest sign in et accedere ad data org. Relinque vacuum ut quaelibet email permittatur.
firebase_email_domains_empty: Nulla restrictio — quaelibet email Google potest sign in (si invitatus / bootstrap).
firebase_member_uid_hint: ID unicum ex Firebase Authentication (non email). Requiritur ut accessum des.
firebase_member_email_hint: Uitur ab regulis securitatis et ad membrum recognoscendum in Firebase.
firebase_tools_body: Instrumenta optionalia quae non mutant backend vivum tuum.
firebase_migrate_section_body: Movet omnia data institutionis ad alium backend et rogat alia instrumenta reconnectere. Solum admin — elige momentum quietum.
sheets_migrate_card_body: Sync tempore reali velocius pro POS et porta. Data Sheets copiata, deinde alia instrumenta rogantur reconnectere.
firebase_tutorial_intro: Elige unum walkthrough completum infra. Uterque finit cum eisdem valoribus in NoctuList. Praefere Firebase Console si novus es in Google Cloud.
firebase_tutorial_oauth_note: OAuth Gmail/email (JSON Desktop developer) separatum est et non debet reuti pro Firebase Sign-In. Utere Web client ID + secret institutionis ex hoc projecto Firebase.
firebase_tutorial_method_firebase_hint: Commendatum: console.firebase.google.com — screens clariores pro Auth, Firestore et config web. Aperi breviter Cloud Console solum pro secret client Web et redirectionibus localhost.
firebase_tutorial_method_cloud_hint: Pro adminibus iam in console.cloud.google.com (idem projectum ac Sheets). Tamen aperi Firebase semel pro Auth Google et Application ID (appId).
firebase_tutorial_copy_rules_done: Copiatum — incolla in Firestore → Rules, deinde Publish
firebase_tutorial_copy_rules_error: Non potui onerare regulas — aperi firebase/firestore.rules in projecto
firebase_tutorial_fb_step1_body:
1. Aperi https://console.firebase.google.com et sign in cum ratione Google institutionis quae potest administrare projectum.
2. Clicca Add project (vel selige existens).
3. Si iam utaris Google Sheets in projecto Cloud: elige «Use an existing Google Cloud project» et idem projectum — ne crea secundum projectum vacuum.
4. Analytics est optionale. Fini wizard.
5. Nota Project ID (Project settings → General). Incollabis in NoctuList.
firebase_tutorial_fb_step2_body:
In Firebase Console, idem projectum:
1. Build → Firestore Database → Create database.
2. Praefere production mode, regio prope loca tua (EU si requiritur), deinde create.
3. Ne adde documenta manu — NoctuList creat sub orgs/{orgId}/…
firebase_tutorial_fb_step3_body:
Firebase Console → Build → Firestore → Rules (URL debet continere /firestore/rules — non Realtime Database).
Selige omnia, incolla regulas NoctuList (button infra), deinde Publish. Sine his regulis instrumenta non possunt secure legere vel scribere.
firebase_tutorial_fb_step4_body:
1. Firebase Console → Build → Authentication → Get started (si opus).
2. Sign-in method → Google → Enable → Save.
3. In ea screen nota Web client ID quod Firebase monstrat pro Google provider — hoc est Web client institutionis (non Gmail Desktop).
4. Si Firebase creat automatice Web OAuth client, serva. Ne substitue cum JSON OAuth Gmail developer.
firebase_tutorial_fb_step5_body:
Serva hanc listam apertam.

A) Config web (facillimum)
• Project settings (gear) → General → Your apps → Web app.
• Si nulla: Add app → Web (</>), nickname «NoctuList», skip Hosting.
• Aperi Config / SDK snippet et copia apiKey, appId, projectId — vel incolla totum snippet in NoctuList «Incolla config web Firebase».

B) Web client ID
• Authentication → Sign-in method → Google → Web client ID
  VEL Project settings → General → Your apps / sectio OAuth
  VEL Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth 2.0 Client IDs → type Web application.
• Incolla in NoctuList → Web client ID.

C) Web client secret (Desktop requiritur)
• Aperi https://console.cloud.google.com → idem projectum → APIs & Services → Credentials.
• Aperi eundem Web application client supra.
• Copia Client secret → NoctuList → Web client secret.
• NON sub «Authorized JavaScript origins» (origines non possunt habere /Callback).
Scroll ad «Authorized redirect URIs» et adde OMNIA haec exacte:
  http://localhost:8889/Callback
  http://localhost:8888/Callback
  http://localhost:8765/Callback
  http://localhost:9090/Callback
Origines optionales (sine path): http://localhost:8889 etc.
→ Save, expecta circiter unum minutum, deinde retry Sign-In.

Instrumenta Android → gradus 6. Desktop solum → gradus 7.
firebase_tutorial_fb_step6_body:
Skip si Desktop solum.
1. Firebase Console → Project settings → Add app → Android.
2. Package name exacte: com.eventmanager.app
3. Adde SHA-1 debug (requiritur pro Google Sign-In):
   macOS/Linux:
   keytool -list -v -keystore ~/.android/debug.keystore -alias androiddebugkey -storepass android -keypass android
   Windows:
   keytool -list -v -keystore %USERPROFILE%\\.android\\debug.keystore -alias androiddebugkey -storepass android -keypass android
4. Optionale download google-services.json in app/google-services.json.
5. In instrumento, adhuc utere Web client ID ex gradu 5 (Android Sign-In eget). Secret solum Desktop.

Si Sign-In defecit: package + SHA-1, Web client ID, Google provider activatus, deinde Sign out / Sign in.
firebase_tutorial_cloud_step1_body:
1. Aperi https://console.cloud.google.com
2. Barra superior → project picker → selige projectum institutionis (idem ac Sheets si iam utaris).
3. Confirma Project ID (chip projecti vel IAM & Admin → Settings). Incollabis in NoctuList.

Liga Firebase semel si opus: https://console.firebase.google.com → Add project → «Use an existing Google Cloud project» → idem projectum. Ne crea projectum vacuum novum.
firebase_tutorial_cloud_step2_body:
Adhuc in Cloud Console, idem projectum:
1. Menu ☰ → APIs & Services → Library → «Cloud Firestore API» → Enable.
2. Menu ☰ → Firestore → Create database si rogatur.
3. Praefere Native / production, regio prope loca, deinde create.
4. Ne adde documenta manu — NoctuList creat orgs/{orgId}/…
firebase_tutorial_cloud_step3_body:
Cloud Console → Firestore → Rules (URL debet continere firestore et rules — non Realtime Database).
Incolla regulas NoctuList (button infra) → Publish.
Si nullus editor Rules in Cloud UI: Firebase Console → Build → Firestore → Rules → incolla → Publish.
firebase_tutorial_cloud_step4_title: 4. Activare Google Sign-In + Web OAuth client
firebase_tutorial_cloud_step4_body:
A) Firebase Auth (semel requiritur)
1. console.firebase.google.com → idem projectum → Authentication → Sign-in method → Google → Enable → Save.

B) Web OAuth client institutionis (non Gmail Desktop)
1. Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials.
2. Sub OAuth 2.0 Client IDs aperi (vel crea) client type Web application usatus ab Firebase Auth.
3. Ne utaris client JSON Gmail Desktop developer pro hoc.
4. NON sub «Authorized JavaScript origins» (origines non possunt habere /Callback).
Scroll ad «Authorized redirect URIs» et adde OMNIA haec exacte:
  http://localhost:8889/Callback
  http://localhost:8888/Callback
  http://localhost:8765/Callback
  http://localhost:9090/Callback
Origines optionales (sine path): http://localhost:8889 etc.
→ Save, expecta circiter unum minutum, deinde retry Sign-In.
5. Copia Client ID et Client secret pro gradu 5.
firebase_tutorial_cloud_step5_body:
A) Project ID — Cloud project picker / IAM & Admin → Settings.

B) API key — Credentials → API keys (Browser key existens, vel Create credentials → API key semel).

C) Web client ID + secret — Credentials → OAuth 2.0 Client IDs → Web application (gradus 4). Incolla utrumque in NoctuList (secret = Desktop Sign-In).

D) Application ID (appId)
• Firebase Console → Project settings → General → Your apps → Web.
• Si nulla: Add app → Web semel, nickname «NoctuList», skip Hosting; copia appId ex config snippet.
• Vel incolla totam config web Firebase in NoctuList.

Android → gradus 6. Desktop solum → gradus 7.
firebase_tutorial_cloud_step6_body:
Android utitur eodem Web OAuth client ac Desktop — NON opus est Android OAuth client vel SHA-1 fingerprint.
1. Cloud Console → Credentials → Web application client tuus (gradus 4).
2. Sub Authorized redirect URIs adde exacte: com.eventmanager.app:/firebaseoauth2callback
3. In NoctuList in phone/tablet: incolla Web client ID + secret (gradus 5), deinde tange Sign in cum Google (browser aperitur).
4. Optionale: Firebase → Add Android app / google-services.json non requiritur pro Sign-In.
firebase_tutorial_step7_body:
In Admin Firebase sync vel dialogo migrationis:
• Organization ID — nomen breve commune (exemplum: noctulist-club). Idem in omni instrumento.
• Project ID, Application ID, API key, Web client ID, et in Desktop Web client secret.
• Vel incolla web config + imple Web client ID/secret, deinde utere join QR pro aliis instrumentis.
Sign in cum Google (primus admin fit org admin). Solum post Sign-In felicem incipe migrationem si transis ex Sheets. Pares join per QR / follow — non debent retypare secreta.
firebase_tutorial_step8_body: In Firestore debes videre orgs/{yourOrgId}/… (guests, members, metadata, etc.). Serva Sheets ut backup donec POS, porta et secundum instrumentum verificata. Billing: mane in free Spark / free tier dum testas; upgrade solum si excedis quotas.
migration_wizard_intro: Solum admin. Copiamus data tua, mutamus hoc instrumentum, deinde annuntiamus mutationem ut alia reconnectant.
migration_wizard_step_config_firebase: Inscribe organisationem Firebase et project details, deinde sign in.
migration_wizard_step_config_sheets: Inscribe spreadsheet destinationis et verifica clavem service account iam uploadatam.
migration_wizard_step_run_body: Serva hanc screen apertam donec finiat. Alia instrumenta monstrabunt prompt reconnect.
migration_wizard_cancel_inflight_hint: Cancel petitum — stop ante backend switch si adhuc possibile.
migration_service_account_ok: Clavis service account inventa in hoc instrumento.
migration_service_account_missing: Upload fasciculum JSON service account Google infra.

follow_need_sign_in: Sign in primum cum Google, deinde tange Connect.
backend_mismatch_billeterie_message: Migratio institutionis facta est. Administrator debet aperire Admin in hoc instrumento ut reconfigurat sync.
backend_mismatch_welcome_body: Aliud instrumentum migravit backend institutionis. Aperi Admin et inscribe nova connection details ut unlock editing.
backend_mismatch_soft_lock: Editing clausum dum migratio backend pendet. Aperi Admin ut reconnectas.
sheets_mirror_section_body: Export unidirectionalis optionale ad spreadsheet separatum dum Firebase est backend vivum.
